notes: Note that 'peur' is feminine, so you must use 'la' or 'une' with it.
It is very commonly used with the verb 'avoir': 'J'ai peur' (I am afraid/I have fear).
Do not confuse it with 'la panique', which describes a much more intense and chaotic reaction.
